description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git rev-list' path optimization features. It defines test cases, sets up a git repository with specific commits and branches, and executes commands to verify path-specific revision listing behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes a given set of commands, and verifies the expected outcome.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp to simulate time progression between commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual outputs, typically for verifying test results.
